company.name: Hinge Health
company.shortDescription: Hinge Health is a digital clinic for joint, and muscle care, pelvic pain, bowel, and bladder control.
company.description: Hinge Health provides digital musculoskeletal care through virtual physical therapy, integrating clinical support with wearable technology and AI tools. Its platform offers personalized exercise programs, remote access to physical therapists, and devices like Enso, an FDA-cleared wearable for pain relief. The company serves employers and health plans aiming to reduce healthcare costs and improve employee well-being. Hinge Health's services address various conditions, including chronic pain and post-surgical recovery, and extend to international markets.

aiResearchSummary.text: Hinge Health is developing computer vision based assessment of posture of living bodies and approaches to posture programs, and patient centered musculoskeletal care systems and associated programs for exercise therapy. It also works on approaches to providing exercise therapy and systems for implementing the same, along with neuromodulation devices and methods for use, waveform generators and electrode interfaces that deliver variable and sequential waveforms for pain and related condition management. Together these focus on digital musculoskeletal care, exercise guidance, and neuromodulation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Secondary Market round raised $200,000,000, or 19.49% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $420,000,000 to $6,200,000,000, a 14.76x increase.
